role: Declares the loot entry and table types, the per-structure chest count kinds, the generated slot and book stack types, and the loot.c entry points.

structs.name: loot_entry
structs.java: WeightedRandomChestContent: theItemId (id and damage), min and max count, itemWeight, plus the func_92112_a book arguments

structs.name: loot_table
structs.java: one structure's WeightedRandomChestContent[] with its name

structs.name: loot_count_kind
structs.java: the count argument each structure call site passes (fixed or 'a + rand.nextInt(b)')

structs.name: loot_stack
structs.java: the ItemStack placed in one IInventory slot

structs.name: loot_book
structs.java: the enchanted book ItemStack a structure builds once and appends via func_92080_a

gpu: lines 36-37, struct loot_table: const pointers to name and entries (read-only data, fine as a constant table)
notes: The slot and book tags are indices into the item tag store (itemtag.h), interned from the enchantment list the book entry builds.
